question: "Dare2eraD TB" by the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, was launched on the occasion of World TB Day by who among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jitendra Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Dare2eraD TB"** by the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, was launched on the occasion of World TB Day.
 
• The initiative was launched by **Dr. Jitendra Singh**.
 
• World TB Day is observed on **March 24** each year to raise public awareness about the devastating health, social, and economic consequences of tuberculosis.
 
• The program aims to eliminate tuberculosis (TB) in India by the year 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tuberculosis is a potentially serious infectious disease that mainly affects the lungs. The bacteria that cause TB are spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.
 
• India has the highest burden of both TB and multidrug-resistant TB. The government has implemented the National Strategic Plan for TB Elimination 2017-2025 to tackle this issue.
 
• The **Revised National TB Control Programme (RNTCP)** is being strengthened and integrated with the health system to ensure comprehensive coverage and effective management of TB cases.
